newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia rubber ends lower on poor demand.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia rubber ends lower on poor demand.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices finished lower in another slow trading day, with falls in Tokyo and poor enquiries easing sentiment, dealers said.
"There were very few enquiries for latex from Asian and European buyers," a dealer said, adding that drum latex prices for nearby are fetching at around 246 to 248 cents.
Results of the South Korean tender for nearby shipments are still unknown. Dealers are also waiting for the return of European interest after summer holidays.
Trading activity slackened with business mainly done on hand-to-mouth basis, a trader said.
She said SMR CV was offered at 375 cents, SMR L at 354, SMR 5 at 325, SMR 10 at 313 and drum latex at 246-250.
At the close, Oct RSS1 buyer was quoted at 328 cents ($1.31) a kg, down half a cent. Oct SMR 20 buyer eased a cent to 314.
The INRO five-day moving average was 250.09 Malaysian/Singapore cents per kg on Sept 16 from 250.24 on Sept 13. The daily indicator price was 249.59 against 250.37.
